all.name: Psylocke
all.description: The psychic warrior known as Sai has the Mutant ability to conjure a variety of weapons with the power of her mind. Gracefully gliding across the battlefield, this trained ninja can shatter the enemy's defenses with a single thought.

item.name: Psionic Blades
item.description: Conjure and slash a pair of psionic blades to inflict damage on enemies.

item.name: Psionic Crossbow
item.description: Unleash bolts with psionic crossbows to damage enemies and reduce the cooldowns of all her abilities.

additional_fields.Fire_Rate: The firing interval between shots is 0.2s, with an interval of 0.6s between each round of shooting
additional_fields.Damage_Falloff: Falloff begins at 15m, decreasing to 70% at 30m

item.name: Wing Shurikens
item.description: Launch a volley of psionic shurikens that stick to enemies, dealing damage and granting herself <Buff>Bonus Health</>. Press again to recall the shurikens.

additional_fields.Casting: Projectile that fires in a straight trajectory.
additional_fields.Damage_Falloff: Falloff begins at 15m, decreasing to 80% at 25m
additional_fields.Special_Mechanic: When the projectile is recalled, it will move 20s toward the crosshair before returning to Psylocke

item.name: Psi-blade Dash
item.description: Dash forward and slice through enemies along the path with psionic blades.

additional_fields.Special_Mechanic: Casting this ability will automatically recall the Wing Shurikens. The shurikens will first travel to Psylocke's starting position before returning to her

item.name: Psychic Stealth
item.description: Enter stealth and gain a <Buff>Movement Boost</>.

additional_fields.Special_Mechanic: When attacked while in stealth, Psylocke will remain in stealth but will briefly become visible for a short duration

item.name: Dance Of The Butterfly
item.description: Slash nearby enemies with a psionic katana, dealing massive damage.

additional_fields.Special_Mechanic: Psylocke will slash a random enemy, giving priority to the one who has been hit the least

item.name: Light Boomerang Dart
item.description: Psylocke launches a Light Boomerang Dart that heals allies, harms enemies, and provides her with continuous healing upon return based on the number of targets hit.

item.name: Dark Dagger
item.description: Psylocke unleashes a ring of Dark Darts that slow enemies while she briefly enters a Phased state.

item.name: Psychic Echoes
item.description: Emma Frost can form a mental link with Psylocke, calling on her to create illusory projections. When together, Emma Frost will create a Mental Projection of Psylocke, forming a Duplicate Illusion in the enemy's perspective that confuses foes by moving and casting abilities on its own.

item.name: Psionic Disc
item.description: When Magik is on the field, {102600} can tap into Limbo to rewind a few seconds back to a previous position; after passing through Limbo, {102600} will gain <Buff>Bonus Health</> based on missing health.
